title: Desmos extension manifest
description: A list of all of the extensions available

extensions.description: Extensions are keyed by id, which is used in almost all places.

defaultExtensions.description: Extensions to load if the URL doesn't specify any

id.description: An extension id: lowercase, and free of the "," and "@" that separate entries and arguments in ?ext=.

name.description: The label in the settings panel. Defaults to the id.

description.description: The tooltip on that label. Defaults to nothing.

supports.description: The calculators this extension is for. Leave it out for all of them. An extension aimed at the wrong calculator is not just useless - DesModder, for one, waits forever on a bundle that calculator never loads - so it is skipped there, and its checkbox is disabled.

file.description: The script to load, resolved against this directory. Defaults to "<id>.js".

mode.description: A calculator, named the way ?type= names it. The aliases and the upstream path names work too.

matrix.name: Matrices
matrix.description: Add matrix support to the graphing calculator.
